title: lepechinia radula
intro: Lepechinia radula, commonly known as Mexican mint, is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Mexico and Central America. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lepechinia radula include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, a digestive aid, and a treatment for various respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
